description: Lead verification: email deliverability signals + LinkedIn URL checks. Use when you need to check that a lead's email address can receive mail (syntax, MX, SPF, DMARC, free or disposable provider) before outreach. Example input: ?email=name@example.com. Returns: syntax_valid, is_free_provider, is_likely_disposable, email_infrastructure, email_deliverability_score, overall_confidence.
name: lead_verify_composite
